description.value: Neptune Wonton Noodle is a fast-casual Chinese noodle restaurant in Richmond operated by the Neptune Restaurant Group, a Greater Vancouver hospitality company established in 1997. The group's sister brand, Neptune Seafood Restaurant, holds membership in the Commanderie des Cordons Bleu de France and has won Vancouver's Top Ten Chinese Restaurant Award, reflecting the culinary pedigree behind the brand. For touring cyclists, it offers a quick, filling Chinese noodle meal with convenient takeout and delivery options in the heart of Richmond.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Neptune Group location at 8171 Ackroyd Road, Richmond, listing phone 604-207-9889 and takeout ordering via multiple delivery apps (FanTuan, Panda, DoorDash, SkipTheDishes, Uber Eats). A unit number discrepancy exists: OSM tags addr:unit=110 but the website shows '100-8171 Ackroyd Road'. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, Wi-Fi, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Unit number discrepancy: OSM tags addr:unit=110 but the website lists the address as '100-8171 Ackroyd Road Richmond, BC'. OSM may have the wrong unit number.
Phone number 604-207-9889 was found on the website but was absent from OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active fast-food Chinese restaurant with confirmed takeout service and a functioning website. A useful food stop for cyclists in Richmond.
